key_facts: On November 1, 2024, CHP Officers Meza-Gonzalez and Melano contacted Plaintiff on the I-580 East shoulder in Livermore (CHP Case RJ68845). The DS-367 chemical-test-refusal designation and Arrest Report triggered DMV APS Case 34739340. After a January 24, 2025 Microsoft Teams hearing, Hearing Officer Diana Candelaria issued a February 11, 2025 Decision sustaining a one-year Class A CDL suspension (Feb. 20, 2025 – Feb. 19, 2026) without addressing the November 5, 2024 PC § 849(b)(1) Detention Certificate. Matter 7 (federal §1983, 2:26-cv-00983-DC-CSK) and Matter 8 (state mandate, 26WM000135, abandoned) litigate that APS outcome. This matter consolidates the underlying incident/APS evidence and both Candelaria docket PDF sets under one owning folder. On August 7, 2026, Plaintiff prepared an operative N.D. Cal. Complaint (v3, 47 pp.) and print intake packet against Candelaria (individual) and Gordon (official capacity), expressly alleging that the prior E.D. Cal. Matter 7 action arising from the same Nov. 1, 2024 incident was voluntarily dismissed without prejudice. Drafts v1 (47 pp.) and v2 (15 pp. short-form) retained.
procedural_status: Opened August 7, 2026 as Matter 33. Received: (a) six Nov. 1, 2024 / APS discovery PDFs plus Centerline wage reference into matter-33/incident/; (b) twelve Matter 7 Candelaria federal PDFs into matter-33/from-07/; (c) six Matter 8 mandamus PDFs into matter-33/from-08/; (d) the June 15, 2026 Candelaria F&R into matter-33/opinions/. Matters 1, 2, 7, 8, and 32 cross-reference these paths. No complaint has been filed under this Matter 33 caption — it is a document-home entry for the Candelaria / DMV APS slice of the CHP cluster. FILED August 7, 2026, 4:05 p.m. PT: N.D. Cal. Complaint (operative v3) and intake packet (JS-44 demanding $250,000 min.; AO 440 summonses for Candelaria and Gordon at DMV Legal Affairs, Sacramento; MJ consent/declination) were filed; case number assignment pending. Related case listed on JS-44: Serrato 4:26-cv-05953-ASK.
damages: N.D. Cal. operative complaint (v3) seeks compensatory damages exceeding $214,000, punitive damages of at least $100,000, JS-44 demand alignment $250,000 (min.), vacatur of APS Case 34739340, SR-22 relief, CDL-record expungement, and structural APS reform. Matter 33 also remains documentary owner of the Matter 7/8 PDF sets (no separate damages under the document-home role).
risk: N.D. Cal. refile after Matter 7 E.D. Cal. voluntary dismissal — confirm dismissal is on the E.D. Cal. docket before filing; watch claim-preclusion / forum-shopping arguments; coordinate with Matter 32 Meza-Gonzalez N.D. Cal. companion and Serrato related-case notice.
